Review dialog: the three faces are one drawn set (RateFace). The first was the icon font's sad outline in the text colour, which looked disabled, beside two colour emoji; the font has no other face. Outlines in the rate-icon colour; the picked face fills with the error, warning or active colour over a halo of its tonal shade, a tenth larger, and the others fade to 0.7, which keeps them at 3:1 against the dialog in both themes (0.4 gave 2:1). The sorry step shows the face picked, not always the sad one. Mdi.EmoticonSadOutline and EyeOffOutline go, unused. Tested in a headless render of both themes and on the pixel_5_-_api_34 emulator

Account page: the premium code opens in a dialog of its own. The row's masked code, with an eye and a copy button of 18 px in the disabled colour, was hard to read and to hit on a phone; a Show code button now opens ViewPremiumCodeDialog - the code in one bold, selectable line, shrunk to a narrow window rather than broken at a dash, and a full-width Copy code button whose icon turns to a check. A code the app cannot get is said in the error dialog, no longer put in the code's place, where Copy copied the error's words. Tested in a headless render of both themes, 390 and 320 wide, and on the pixel_5_-_api_34 emulator
